name: Copy
description: Copies the selected objects (or materials, in material mode) to a clipboard slot that any 3ds Max instance can paste, locally or on the active network target. Hold keys while clicking to pick the slot: none 1, Shift 2, Ctrl 3, Alt 4, Shift+Ctrl 5, Shift+Alt 6, Ctrl+Alt 7, Shift+Ctrl+Alt 8.
author: Open3DS contributors
